usage: Common business noun for rivalry between companies, products, or people.
Usually used in phrases like 競爭激烈, 競爭對手, and 市場競爭.
Can be used for broad market or industry context, not only direct one-to-one fights.
Sounds neutral and fairly formal; good for news, business talk, and school learning.
